findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: If `len` is larger than the allocated size of `ptr`, it could lead to a buffer overflow.
findings.assumptions: The size of `ptr` is not checked against `len`. The `size * nmemb` calculation assumes that the buffer pointed to by `ptr` is large enough to hold the data being copied.

findings.title: OS Command Injection

findings.assumptions: The `ptr` data is attacker-controlled and is being printed directly to the console without any sanitization.
